sources.title: Explore Model Garden | Google AI Edge | Google for Developers
sources.snippet: Model Garden provides a collection of state-of-the-art machine learning (ML) models for vision, text, and audio capabilities. These models are optimized for use with the Google Tensor SDK, letting you bring powerful AI features directly to your Pixel devices with seamless on-device performance.
